scraped.scraped_description: A participatory, gift-based gathering of art, science, wellbeing, culture and more — powered by Wisdom.

name: Open Heart Mind (OHM)
tagline: Participatory gatherings and regenerative systems for collective flourishing — developing Wisdom, an open-source peer evaluation platform
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 — Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
academic_citations: AIMOS 2023 conference presentation on Metavaluation framework
outcome_methodology: Participatory peer evaluation — peer reviews treated as contributions in their own right to generate community-driven value metrics
documented_limitations: early-stage; limited evidence base beyond small pilot gatherings
experimental framework not yet validated at scale
failure_modes: insufficient adoption to achieve network effects
curation_criteria: Community peer evaluation via Wisdom; contributions assessed collectively rather than by central authority
contributor_governance: All participants can contribute and earn recognition; contributions tracked and rewarded through Wisdom peer evaluation system
community_ownership: Gift-based, community co-created events and platform; all research and tools freely available under open source licences
ai_involvement: Research question explicitly exploring training AI systems on participatory community value systems as alternative to internet scraping
political_relevance_summary: Open Heart Mind (OHM) addresses gaps in democratic participation by providing tools or platforms that enable citizens and communities to engage more directly in governance and decision-making processes.

movement_building_utility.notes: Open Heart Mind (OHM)'s primary function is not directly oriented toward civic organizing, advocacy, or movement infrastructure.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. Open Heart Mind (OHM) is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.
